shortDescription: Encrypted diary with offline search. Pro adds ad-free use and local statistics.
fullDescription:
Keep thoughts, events and memories on your own device. The search model is bundled in the app. Writing, word and semantic search, locking, import and backups are free and work offline.

A PLACE TO WRITE
• Entries with dates, times, optional moods and tags.
• A calm editor with large text and an expandable Details menu.
• Automatic draft saving with cursor recovery.
• Calendar, favorites and On this day memories.
• A 30-day trash folder and optional local reminders.

SEARCH ON YOUR DEVICE
Find words and fragments inside words, tags, or related meanings in English and Russian. Filter by dates, mood and tags, then open a matching fragment in the editor.
Semantic search is approximate and may miss relevant entries or return nearby topics. No cloud processing or in-app model download is used.

PROTECTED WRITING
Entries, drafts and search vectors are stored in an encrypted database. Access is protected by a PIN and optional biometrics, with automatic locking and protection against ordinary screenshots and recent-app previews.
Entry text, moods, tags, vectors and search queries are not sent to the ad service, payment server or developer. There is no cloud sync.

FREE AND PRO
Installation is free. The free version offers Yandex ads when you choose to watch after a data explanation. Viewing requires internet and sends an IP address and technical device data; the SDK uses technical telemetry. Declining, an ad error or no connection does not block your diary.
Pro costs RUB 99 per calendar month and removes ads while adding on-device mood, tag and writing statistics. Statistics summarize selected marks and do not make medical assessments.
Each month of access is purchased separately through SBP in a YooKassa payment form, independently of the store payment service. Renewal is manual with no automatic debits. Payment, status checking and Pro recovery require a connection; confirmed access works offline until its stated expiry. Core features remain free after expiry.

IMPORT AND BACKUPS
Import TXT/Markdown, export a Markdown ZIP, or create a password-protected encrypted backup. Markdown is plain text; a system file provider you choose may be a cloud service. Export starts only when you choose it.

The PIN and backup password cannot be recovered. Drafts and trash are excluded from backups. The local model needs available storage and memory; speed depends on your device.

Android 8.0 or later. English and Russian, with light and dark themes.
